fields.summary_ko.0: MSFT's global outage disabled Microsoft 365 apps including Outlook across 74 countries, affecting over 430 million people.
fields.summary_ko.1: Copilot became inaccessible to email, files, and calendars; OpenAI ChatGPT and Anthropic Claude connectors also went down, marking at least the sixth MSFT update error in six months.
fields.summary_ko.2: Microsoft commits to 99.9% uptime with credits of 25–100% of monthly fees for SLA violations, yet similar incidents have recurred multiple times this year.
